newsitem.title: GREECE: WORDS MUST MATCH DEEDS SAYS SALONICA'S CHAMBER OF COMMERCE.
newsitem.headline: WORDS MUST MATCH DEEDS SAYS SALONICA'S CHAMBER OF COMMERCE.

text.p: There is a great distance between describing economic problems and taking decisive, bold measures to tackle them and lead Greece into the EMU, Salonica's commerce and industry chamber said in a statement.

"There is a great distance that cannot be bridged by unclear statements," it said. The statement was referring to the Greek premier's policy speech on Thursday night which was described by market players today as general and timid.
The chamber said it would critically support the government's choices provided that the usefulness of the proposed measures is proven, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
